I start going through summaries

                                        There were no pairs of loci meeting the criteria. 

 > summary(HPLscan2,perms =HPLscan2.perm2, alphas = c(0.5,0.5,0,0.5,0.5),pvalues = TRUE) 
                                        There were no pairs of loci meeting the criteria. 

QUESTION
